sloka: यद्रक्षति महावीर्यः सदा दधिमुखः कपिः ।मातुलः कपिमुख्यस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ।। ५.६१.९ ।।।।
transliteration: yadrakṣati mahāvīryaḥ sadā dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ ।mātulaḥ kapimukhyasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 5.61.9 ।।।।

translations.english: Dadhimukha, the foremost of all monkeys, of great valour and the maternal uncle of Sugriva was the caretaker of the garden.
